# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 yuan-haiyun1, the Yuan's sea transport and grain (oe_yh_). Generated by gen_yuan_haiyun.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES id 38 "yh") while
# OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_init } }. This line writes no monthly hook of its own.
# Order: start, close, the warlords and the route, the month's use, February, May, the tier, January's renewal, the events.
oe_yh_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_init } } oe_yh_setup = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now }
        oe_yh_end_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on }
            oe_yh_watch = yes
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_grain subtract = global_var:oe_yh_use }
            clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_grain min = 0 max = 500 }
            if = { limit = { current_month = 2 oe_yh_feb_done = no } oe_yh_feb = yes }
            if = { limit = { current_month = 5 oe_yh_may_done = no } oe_yh_may = yes }
            oe_yh_tier_step = yes
            if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_yh_apply_mods = yes }
            oe_yh_ev_lapse = yes
            oe_yh_ev_pick = yes
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
    }
}
# Any scope. The first run in a game: before 1368.1.1 and with a Mongol Yuan the line opens (design: a 1337 game; the scheduler
# runs only there). Otherwise it stays off (oe_yh_end 8 too late, 4 no Mongol Yuan).
oe_yh_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yh_init
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1368.1.1 oe_yh_yuan_ok = yes }
        set_global_variable = oe_yh_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_grain value = 260 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_use value = 21 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_route value = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_fang value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang_n value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_tuntian value = 0 }
        oe_yh_watch = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_tier value = oe_yh_tier_calc }
        oe_yh_apply_mods = yes
        debug_log = "oe_yh: the line opens (granary 260, tier [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_tier')|0])"
    }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1368.1.1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_end value = 8 } debug_log = "oe_yh: too late, the line stays off (code 8)" }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_end value = 4 } debug_log = "oe_yh: no Mongol Yuan, the line stays off (code 4)" }
}
# Any scope (F6's COLLAPSE_HOOKS, a hook; also this line's own monthly check). The Yuan has fallen: the line ends with code 4.
oe_yh_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on } oe_yh_finish = { code = 4 } }
}
# Any scope, monthly. The end: the collapse or no longer a Mongol Yuan (4), 1400.1.1 (5).
oe_yh_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { OR = { oe_yh_fallen = yes oe_yh_yuan_ok = no } } oe_yh_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1400.1.1 } oe_yh_finish = { code = 5 } }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_yh_finish = { code = N }: every modifier of this line off, the line closed (oe_yh_end = N).
oe_yh_finish = {
    oe_yh_strip = yes
    remove_global_variable = oe_yh_on
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_end value = $code$ }
    debug_log = "oe_yh: the line ends (code in oe_yh_end)"
}
# Any scope. Removes this line's modifiers: the tier on the Yuan, Dadu's, the farms' on the two provinces.
oe_yh_strip = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yh_full } remove_country_modifier = oe_yh_full } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yh_short } remove_country_modifier = oe_yh_short } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yh_famine } remove_country_modifier = oe_yh_famine } } }
    location:dadu = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yh_short_dadu } remove_location_modifier = oe_yh_short_dadu } if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yh_famine_dadu } remove_location_modifier = oe_yh_famine_dadu } if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yh_closed } remove_location_modifier = oe_yh_closed } }
    location:dadu = { province = { if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = oe_yh_fields } remove_province_modifier = oe_yh_fields } } } location:luxian = { province = { if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = oe_yh_fields } remove_province_modifier = oe_yh_fields } } }
}
# Any scope (interface, design 4.4). Usage: oe_yh_add_grain = { amount = N }: the granary 0-500 (the tier follows next month).
oe_yh_add_grain = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_grain add = $amount$ }
        clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_grain min = 0 max = 500 }
    }
}
# Any scope. Debug counter: events sent by this line (global oe_dbg_n_yh).
oe_yh_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_yh } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yh value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yh add = 1 }
}
# Any scope, monthly. The warlords and the sea route (design 3.2):
# * Fang Guozhen (oe_yh_fang 0 not yet, 1 at sea and hunted, 2 amnestied, 3 rebelled again): a CFN that has come over counts as
#   amnestied; after an amnesty, a CFN at war with the Yuan that has not come over has rebelled again.
# * The route (oe_yh_route 2 open, 1 blocked, 0 cut): cut without Zhigu or without any of the twelve places in the Yuan's or a
#   loyal warlord's hands; blocked while CFN is hostile, or until the end of 1350 after .1 a.
# * Zhang Shicheng (oe_yh_zhang 0 none, 1 levy sent, 2 delivered this year, 3 refused, 4 levy given up): a Wu that turns away
#   while the levy stands refuses (.4, reason 2); a levy given up is forgotten once Wu is no longer fit; no Wu, no levy.
# * The farms (oe_yh_tuntian 0 none, 1 working, 2 lost): lost with the capital area, and their province modifier with them.
oe_yh_watch = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CFN c:CFN = { oe_yh_aligned = yes } NOT = { global_var:oe_yh_fang ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_fang value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_fang ?= 2 oe_yh_cfn_hostile = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_fang value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yh_route_open = no } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_route value = 0 } }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { oe_yh_cfn_hostile = yes AND = { global_var:oe_yh_fang ?= 1 current_date < 1351.1.1 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_route value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_route value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_zhang ?= 4 oe_yh_wuu_ok = no } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 0 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_yh_zhang ?= 1 global_var:oe_yh_zhang ?= 2 } country_exists = c:WUU c:WUU = { oe_yh_aligned = no } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 3 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d4 value = 2 }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:WUU } OR = { global_var:oe_yh_zhang ?= 1 global_var:oe_yh_zhang ?= 2 global_var:oe_yh_zhang ?= 3 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 0 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d3 } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_d3 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d4 } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_d4 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_tuntian ?= 1 oe_yh_cap_held = no } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_tuntian value = 2 } location:dadu = { province = { if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = oe_yh_fields } remove_province_modifier = oe_yh_fields } } } location:luxian = { province = { if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = oe_yh_fields } remove_province_modifier = oe_yh_fields } } } }
}
# Any scope, February (design: .3 every February). A Wu fit for the levy and no levy pending: .3 is due.
oe_yh_feb = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_feb_y value = oe_yh_year_now }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yh_wuu_ok = yes OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_zhang } global_var:oe_yh_zhang ?= 0 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d3 value = 1 }
    }
}
# Any scope, May (design 3.2: the grain fleet reaches the capital in May). The four sources, the granary, then the notice .2 when
# something changed (r2: 3 Zhang's first grain, 1 a fall of 20% or more, 2 the tier changed, 4 the first settlement of the game),
# and the tier's yearly weight on the suppression (phases 1-3) and on the princes.
oe_yh_may = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_may_y value = oe_yh_year_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_arrive } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_arrive_last value = global_var:oe_yh_arrive } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_sea value = oe_yh_sea_calc }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_canal value = oe_yh_canal_calc }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_farm value = oe_yh_farm_calc }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_warlord value = oe_yh_warlord_calc }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_arrive value = oe_yh_arrive_calc }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_grain add = global_var:oe_yh_arrive }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_grain min = 0 max = 500 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_tier_new value = oe_yh_tier_calc }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_first_w } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_first_w }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yh_warlord > 0 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_yh_zhang_n > 0 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_first_w value = 1 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang_n add = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { oe_yh_sup_running = yes } oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_yh_toqto = yes } oe_y7_add_court = { amount = 2 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_d2 }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_first_w ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d2 value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_arrive_last oe_yh_ratio < 80 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d2 value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_tier_may NOT = { global_var:oe_yh_tier_may = global_var:oe_yh_tier_new } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d2 value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_tier_may } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d2 value = 4 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_tier_new = 1 } if = { limit = { oe_yh_sup_running = yes } oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = -2 } } if = { limit = { oe_yh_toqto = yes } oe_y7_add_court = { amount = -2 } } }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_tier_new = 0 } if = { limit = { oe_yh_sup_running = yes } oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = -5 } } oe_yw_change_loyalty_all = { amount = -2 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_tier_may value = global_var:oe_yh_tier_new }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yh_tier_new
    debug_log = "oe_yh: May, arrived [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_arrive')|0] (sea [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_sea')|0] canal [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_canal')|0] farms [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_farm')|0] Zhang [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_warlord')|0]), granary [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_grain')|0]"
}
# Any scope. The tier from the granary; on a change the modifiers follow, and a fall into tier 0 makes .5 due (at most every
# 24 months).
oe_yh_tier_step = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_tier_new value = oe_yh_tier_calc }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_yh_tier_new = global_var:oe_yh_tier } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_tier_new = 0 global_var:oe_yh_m >= oe_yh_m5_next } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d5 value = 1 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_tier value = global_var:oe_yh_tier_new }
        oe_yh_apply_mods = yes
    }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yh_tier_new
}
# Any scope. The tier's modifiers for 13 months (mode = replace: renewed, never stacked; on a change and every January).
oe_yh_apply_mods = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yh_full } remove_country_modifier = oe_yh_full } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yh_short } remove_country_modifier = oe_yh_short } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yh_famine } remove_country_modifier = oe_yh_famine } if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_tier ?= 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yh_full months = 13 mode = replace } } if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_tier ?= 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yh_short months = 13 mode = replace } } if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_tier ?= 0 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yh_famine months = 13 mode = replace } } } }
    location:dadu = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yh_short_dadu } remove_location_modifier = oe_yh_short_dadu } if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yh_famine_dadu } remove_location_modifier = oe_yh_famine_dadu } if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI global_var:oe_yh_tier ?= 1 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_yh_short_dadu months = 13 mode = replace } } if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI global_var:oe_yh_tier ?= 0 } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_yh_famine_dadu months = 13 mode = replace } } }
}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- events: senders and the pick (Y4 / Y1 / y7 pattern)
oe_yh_fire_1 = {
    
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_st_1 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yh_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_wait value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_last value = 1 }
    oe_yh_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yh: event oe_yh.1 sent to CHI"
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yh.1 } }
}

# Any scope. Drops what can no longer come: a rolled event after its grace; a levy whose Wu is no longer fit; a refusal whose Wu
# is gone.
oe_yh_ev_lapse = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yh_lapse_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_st_1 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yh: event oe_yh.1 dropped (window over)" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yh_lapse_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_st_6 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yh: event oe_yh.6 dropped (window over)" }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d3 oe_yh_wuu_ok = no } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d3 } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_d3 } if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_zhang ?= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 0 } } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d4 NOT = { country_exists = c:WUU } } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d4 } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_d4 } }
}
# Any scope. At most one event a month: a due event first (.5 .4 .3 .2), else one roll per open event. Nothing in a month in
# which another Yuan line already sent the Yuan an event, but a due event waits at most 2 such months.
oe_yh_ev_pick = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_yh_busy = no global_var:oe_yh_wait >= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_yh_due_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_pick value = 5 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yh_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_pick value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yh_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_pick value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yh_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_pick value = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 0 oe_yh_busy = no }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 0 oe_yh_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yh_ch_1 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 0 oe_yh_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yh_ch_6 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_pick value = 6 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 0 oe_yh_busy = yes oe_yh_any_due = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_wait add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 1 } oe_yh_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 2 } oe_yh_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 3 } oe_yh_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 4 } oe_yh_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 5 } oe_yh_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_pick = 6 } oe_yh_fire_6 = yes }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yh_pick
}

# ---- worker jobs (hidden event oe_yh.20, CHI scope; country var oe_yh_job). No debug_log here (CMDLOG: options reach them).
oe_yh_job_1 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_fang value = 1 } }
oe_yh_job_2 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_fang value = 2 } }
oe_yh_job_3 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_roll value = 0 } random = { chance = oe_yh_p3_sv set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_roll value = 1 } } if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yh_roll = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 2 } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:WUU } c:WUU = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = -5 } } } } else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 3 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d4 value = 1 } } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_roll }
oe_yh_job_4 = { if = { limit = { country_exists = c:WUU } c:WUU = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 15 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 0 } }
oe_yh_job_5 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 4 } }
oe_yh_job_6 = { oe_yh_add_grain = { amount = 30 } }
oe_yh_job_8 = { oe_yh_add_grain = { amount = 20 } }
oe_yh_job_9 = { location:dadu = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_yh_closed months = 12 mode = replace } } }
oe_yh_job_10 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_tuntian value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_fields_m value = global_var:oe_yh_m } location:dadu = { province = { add_province_modifier = { modifier = oe_yh_fields years = 30 mode = replace } } } location:luxian = { province = { add_province_modifier = { modifier = oe_yh_fields years = 30 mode = replace } } } }
oe_yh_job_11 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_zhang value = 0 } }

# ---- TEST ONLY (DEV_LINES; the current player's country scope)
# For the CURRENT player's country when it is the Yuan (r21: an event sent to the AI Yuan cannot be read): runs the event's sender
# (so a number it stores, such as .3's chance, is computed) and sends the event to that country; the event's own trigger still
# applies. A rolled event counts as not yet sent before (it can be tried again).
oe_yh_test_me_1 = { if = { limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now } } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_st_1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_st_1 } oe_yh_fire_1 = yes } else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yh.1 not sent" } }
oe_yh_test_me_2 = { if = { limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d2 value = 4 } } oe_yh_fire_2 = yes } else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yh.2 not sent" } }
oe_yh_test_me_3 = { if = { limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now } } oe_yh_fire_3 = yes } else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yh.3 not sent" } }
oe_yh_test_me_4 = { if = { limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d4 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_d4 value = 1 } } oe_yh_fire_4 = yes } else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yh.4 not sent" } }
oe_yh_test_me_5 = { if = { limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now } } oe_yh_fire_5 = yes } else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yh.5 not sent" } }
oe_yh_test_me_6 = { if = { limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now } } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_st_6 } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_st_6 } oe_yh_fire_6 = yes } else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yh.6 not sent" } }
# The line from now on: everything cleared, then the start (the date and a Mongol Yuan still apply).
oe_yh_test_start = {
    oe_yh_test_clear = yes
    oe_yh_setup = yes
    oe_yh_log = yes
}
# One month of the line now (the scheduler's call; the month index moves to today).
oe_yh_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on } oe_yh_monthly = yes oe_yh_log = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the line is not running (press yhstart first)" }
}
# The May settlement now (its year mark cleared first), then the tier.
oe_yh_test_may = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_may_y } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_may_y }
        oe_yh_may = yes
        oe_yh_tier_step = yes
        oe_yh_log = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the line is not running (press yhstart first)" }
}
# The February check now (its year mark cleared first): .3 becomes due when Wu is fit.
oe_yh_test_feb = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_feb_y } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_feb_y }
        oe_yh_watch = yes
        oe_yh_feb = yes
        oe_yh_log = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the line is not running (press yhstart first)" }
}
# Usage: oe_yh_test_grain = { amount = N }: the granary set to N, then the tier (a fall into 0 makes .5 due).
oe_yh_test_grain = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_m value = oe_yh_m_now }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yh_grain value = $amount$ }
        oe_yh_tier_step = yes
        oe_yh_log = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yh TEST: the line is not running (press yhstart first)" }
}
# Stand-ins (design 4.5 yhwu; as the Ilkhanate line's stand-in Timurids, r21): where Wu (WUU) is missing, the Yuan's Wuxian (Suzhou)
# goes to WUU, which wakes it; where Fang (CFN) is missing, the Yuan's Yinxian (Ningbo) goes to CFN. Each gets vanilla's allegiance
# 60 (come over to the Yuan). Test games only: it changes the map.
oe_yh_test_wu = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:WUU } location:wuxian = { owner ?= c:CHI has_siege = no is_capital = no } } location:wuxian = { change_location_owner = c:WUU } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:WUU } c:WUU = { set_variable = { name = rtr_yuan_allegiance value = 60 } } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:CFN } location:yinxian = { owner ?= c:CHI has_siege = no is_capital = no } } location:yinxian = { change_location_owner = c:CFN } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CFN } c:CFN = { set_variable = { name = rtr_yuan_allegiance value = 60 } } }
    oe_yh_log = yes
}
# Probe (design 5.2 item 8, vanilla's own effect, town_rights_events.4): Dadu's province food stock +10% of its capacity, with the
# readings before and after.
oe_yh_test_food = {
    debug_log = "oe_yh probe before: Dadu province food [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_pfood')|0]% market food [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_mfood')|0]%"
    location:dadu = { province = { change_province_food_percentage = 0.1 } }
    debug_log = "oe_yh probe after: Dadu province food [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_pfood')|0]% market food [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yh_rd_mfood')|0]%"
}
# Vanilla's canal damage mark (flavor_chi.30 sets it, .124 and .87 repair it) switched: set when missing, removed when set, to see
# the canal share of the May settlement. Test games only.
oe_yh_test_canal = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = china_grand_canal_sustained_damage } remove_global_variable = china_grand_canal_sustained_damage }
    else = { set_global_variable = china_grand_canal_sustained_damage }
    oe_yh_log = yes
}
# Everything of this line cleared and its modifiers off; the line starts again at the next monthly round.
oe_yh_test_clear = {
    oe_yh_strip = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_on }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_init } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_init }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_end } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_end }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_m } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_grain } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_grain }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_use } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_use }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_tier } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_tier }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_tier_new } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_tier_new }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_tier_may } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_tier_may }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_route } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_route }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_fang } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_fang }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_zhang } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_zhang }

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_d5 } remove_global_variable = oe_yh_d5 }
